# Andersen 400 Series DH (Double Hung) - Research Findings Document

## 1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW

**Andersen 400 Series Woodwright Double-Hung Full-Frame Windows**
- Manufacturer: Andersen Corporation, United States
- 
400 Series windows are vinyl-clad windows...vinyl-clad windows are windows with a wood frame that have an exterior cover such as fiberglass, vinyl, or aluminum. In this case, the windows have a wood interior and vinyl exterior

- **Configuration**: DH (Double Hung) - 
Woodwright windows are built with Easy Tilt-Release locks making cleaning and maintenance easier...Cleaning your window is easier with easy tilt-release technology. All you do is push your thumb forward and the window tilts inward

- **Country of Origin**: United States (Andersen Corporation, Minnesota)

### Air Infiltration Performance Concerns


Some people have complained of these Andersen 400 Series windows being a bit drafty and letting in cold air. With an air infiltration rating of <0.30, you shouldn't have to expect any drafts, especially when considering that this window has a much tighter seal than competing windows.
